# Final verification explanation

Result: workflow-final-verification, governed-final, branch-ready. Exact change 2026-09-08-skill-model-proposal-family-pilot; branch proposal/skill-model-proposal-family-pilot. Both allocated milestones are completed, all four recorded findings have original-reporter resolutions, current Design/Delivery r3 are approved, and fresh independent whole-change code-review-final-r2 is approved. This is a distinct Verify assessment, not a replacement review.

## Change and rationale

The shared Skill model now defines actionable preserved metadata, role-summary, vocabulary, portability and resource rules with their original populations and explicit supersessions. Skill/System and current consumers agree on ownership. Proposal/proposal-review place invocation classification before detailed recording construction and load complete existing references when triggered; portable authoring and independent advisory assessment keep their own authority. Validator selection protects missing/escaped/unreadable/unknown content and current review placement. Current v0.5.1 candidate metadata describes regenerated package bytes. Four source snapshots retain exact original bytes and accessible related navigation; mixed plan/boundary definitions remain current. FU-015–018 assign the remaining17 skills to receiving owners and next adoption decisions. The stale lifecycle sentence and stale test-asset consumer found at final review are corrected without changing requirements or deleting tests.

## Exact basis and evidence

Accepted direction is proposal-review on the unchanged registered proposal. Design Review r3 covers exact Skill/System and the retained package; Delivery Review r3 covers the unchanged primary plan and current Design basis. Earlier assessments retain their original subjects and historical meaning. Final Code Review r2 independently assessed the complete engineering diff and cross-milestone interactions plus both final corrections. This report's subjects bind current engineering, relied-on assessments and current evidence; the registry points to the actual current proposal/models/plan.

TG-01–03 realize SKL-SR-02–20 and scoped SYS-SR-02/04 through classification-first ordinary/governed/formal path walkthroughs, unchanged output assets and specialist policy, production negative tests and canonical-to-candidate checks. TG-04–05 realize SKL-SR-01–15/20–23 and SYS-SR-02/04/06/07 through precise current rule/population mappings, validator consumers, four original-byte snapshots, 73 related navigation targets and named receiving families. TG-FINAL-01 composes current candidate procedure/resources, missing-method and moved-heading rejection, ownership transfer, archive readability and unchanged-skill coexistence. Independent assessments establish usefulness/coherence; mechanical checks do not claim universal agent correctness.

Actual final command: bash scripts/ci.sh --mode pr --base ffb58ecb2b8879926eaa1db0784761768ffb303e --head 24c92999e8cd16d61e942a6b6a9f5100a1e064ab --timeout 1200 --jobs 4. All21 selected checks passed, including full110 lifecycle regressions, full358 skill regressions, generator, adapter, current immutable v2 lifecycle/record, model/schema, guide, selector, CLI and npm-package tests. Focused architecture-contract regression passed1. python scripts/validate-boundary-first.py --check --path docs/design/skill/skill.md --path docs/design/system/system.md and python scripts/validate-documentation-prose.py --mode enforce --path docs/design/skill/skill.md passed after the Design correction. python scripts/validate-adapters.py --version v0.5.1 --adapter-root /tmp/skl-m1-candidate-yxrafnjn and python scripts/build-skills.py --check passed. Final byte checks confirm all three archives match current metadata sizes/hashes, 133 of137 canonical files are unchanged, the other four are the named pilot files, and historical release-index entries are unchanged. Full-branch git diff --check passed.

Broad evidence is explicitly composed, not an overall broad-run pass: the original bash scripts/ci.sh --mode broad-smoke --jobs 4 exited1. Its ten successful children remain applicable to unchanged subjects; complete adapter regression included158 tests. The failed lifecycle fixture was corrected and its whole110-test suite rerun successfully in final CI. The other failed child intentionally rejects v2 roots through the retired legacy-review adapter; supported current v2 immutable lifecycle and record checks passed and cover this change. Delivery r3 and final reviewer accepted this disposition. final-correction-proof records exact successful child commands, failure reasons and unaffected reuse basis. No failed command was relabeled passed, no test was deleted and no legacy runtime was restored.

Engineering is unchanged after24c92999: subsequent commits contain only attributable correction-proof, independent final review/finding disposition and workflow handoff records. Original narrative sidecars are fully preserved as registered evidence text with original paths/raw-byte hashes; prior missing-note observations are historical provenance. Old engineering hashes in earlier assessments are not current approval. Current reliance uses renewed r3/final-r2 assessments and final-correction-proof. Record-only hash drift from added evidence or reporter-owned disposition does not change the reviewed engineering basis; original judgments remain intact.

## Impact and limitations

Affected: published pilot procedure, validation selection/protection, generated candidate metadata, common governance/source ownership, archival navigation and proof/test consumers. Unaffected: executable CLI/API behavior, record schemas/persistence, dependencies, operational resource manifests/templates, other17 canonical skills, historical release data and customer environments; the actual diff contains no changes to those implementations or populations, and direct preservation/protection checks support this boundary. Security/authority conditions remain enforced; no execution/publication authority is inferred. No new distribution/installation mechanism, service, inventory-wide adoption or target-agent benchmark is introduced. Unrelated historical lifecycle-language warnings remain baseline context, not current blocking findings.

Residual risk is semantic misuse or future adoption outside the assessed pair; later families require explicit baseline/decision/proof. Restore displaced source and governance/consumer references together if rollback is needed; restore pilot content and candidate metadata as a coupled unit if necessary. Preserve historical evidence throughout. Hosted CI is unobserved before submission, not passed; local proof and repository closeout do not authorize merge or release. User explicitly authorized PR submission, which remains the separate next external operation.
